scenario.title: Réaction en chaîne
scenario.description: Un chariot percute une file de charges. Le dernier transporteur porte un équipement fragile.
scenario.challenge: Couper la chaîne avant le premier contact.

deadline.scope: Last safe delay among a 0.25-second grid and the stated discrete intervention set; not a continuous guarantee.

robustness.scope: Three simulated speed checks only; no probabilistic or physical guarantee.

plan.objective: Among evaluated actions below the protected-impact energy threshold, minimize applied impulse. If none succeeds, minimize protected-impact energy, then impulse.
plan.scope: All trajectories are frozen before playback using one supplied simulation model. Same-model counterfactual comparison, not held-out prediction accuracy.
